title: Print two lines
promptHtml:
Write a program that prints exactly two lines:

Both lines end with a newline. The starter already prints the first line; add the second.
hints:
A second std::cout << ...; statement runs after the first one.

Every line needs its own \n. Without it both lines run together.
solutionNotesHtml: You could also write it as one statement — std::cout << "Hello, machine\n" << "Goodbye, machine\n"; — because << returns the stream, so the calls chain. Both compile to the same thing.
